points: \item Architected and deployed a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for enterprise business applications, improving document QA accuracy by ~20% and enabling scalable Gen AI solutions with prompt engineering best practices.

\item Engineered hybrid retrieval workflows combining dense embeddings (FAISS) with BM25 search for LlamaIndex-powered applications, achieving 35% improvement in retrieval relevance for real-world business problem-solving at scale.

\item Developed LLM-as-Judge evaluation framework to assess model performance, faithfulness, and deployment readiness across hundreds of Gen AI test cases, ensuring production-grade reliability in cloud-based AI solutions.

\item Optimized LLM inference through batched query extraction and fine-tuning techniques, reducing API calls by ~80% and cutting costs by 60% while maintaining sub-second latency for business-critical AI applications.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for production workflows, reducing operational errors by 25% while maintaining system reliability and collaborating with software engineers and cloud architects on AI deployment.

\item Fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B using QLoRA on domain-specific business data with 4-bit quantization, gaining hands-on experience in parameter-efficient LLM training and innovative AI-powered application development for industrial use cases.
